128x128, 12 frames @ 10 fps, plays once; anchor (feet) at 64,97
still warns: frames 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 11 show no effect at all; check life windows and intensity; trail_7 is drawn behind the sprite and 100% of it is hidden by the sprite: make it reach past the sprite's outline, move it, or put what should show in front (z front; orbits: depth auto); fade_7 is drawn behind the sprite and 100% of it is hidden by the sprite: make it reach past the sprite's outline, move it, or put what should show in front (z front; orbits: depth auto). The user gets it as saved: fix it on step cef53f5c-efe0-4eee-912e-0871531d7261 and export again with --replace 8a8df3ce-c831-4251-967d-2ec0320b7bb8, or say why it is right as it is.
